Author: Johnneylee Jack Rollins
Name: XivArcade
Punchline: Your own classic games as game panels, with saves kept in step across your machines.
Description: A library for the classic games you own, for FINAL FANTASY XIV running under Wine on Linux. /arcade lists the game files in folders you choose, Final Fantasy first, starts them in RetroArch on the Linux host, and shows them as world panels through ghostty-dalamud when it is installed. Every save and save state lives in one folder that Syncthing copies between your machines. XivArcade downloads no games, BIOS files or artwork: bring your own dumps of games you own. Not yet verified in game.
